The shuttle carries the die in under the leadscrew and the guard comes down: the press won't start with it up. V1 opens to the pump, slowly at first through the needle valve so the powder stays put. Air leaves the cup through the plug's vent and out of the die's port: under 1 mbar in about 2 min.

Start: program 1 pumps up to 3.2 t (31.4 kN). The ram lifts the die 2 mm to the leadscrew, then drives the plug 8.0 mm to flush: the powder goes from 52 to 63 % dense, with no air in it (DAL #140). It holds a minute, topping the load up as the powder settles; F1 takes what's left once the plug is flush.
